movieQuotes.movieTitle: 奇幻屋的夜晚（原創情境）
movieQuotes.quote: The house is quiet, but my mind is awake.
movieQuotes.translation: 這棟屋子很安靜，但我的腦袋仍然清醒。
movieQuotes.vibe: 哥德奇幻、安靜觀察、細膩角色感

targetPhonics.rule: qu 常一起出現；分成兩個音節慢讀
a- 是非重讀開頭；a_e 發長母音 /eɪ/

roleplayDialogue.speaker: 知諭
roleplayDialogue.en: The house is quiet, but my mind is awake.
roleplayDialogue.zh: 這棟屋子很安靜，但我的腦袋仍然清醒。

roleplayDialogue.speaker: AI 角色夥伴
roleplayDialogue.en: What detail do you notice in this quiet house?
roleplayDialogue.zh: 在這棟安靜的屋子裡，你注意到了什麼細節？

movieQuotes.quote: I notice the details that others miss.
movieQuotes.translation: 我注意到其他人錯過的細節。
movieQuotes.vibe: 懸疑推理、角色觀察、冷靜自信

roleplayDialogue.speaker: 知諭
roleplayDialogue.en: I notice the details that others miss.
roleplayDialogue.zh: 我注意到其他人錯過的細節。

movieQuotes.quote: Change starts with you. It starts with all of us.
movieQuotes.translation: 改變從你開始，從我們每一個人開始。
movieQuotes.vibe: 溫暖勵志、同儕共好、活潑溫柔

targetPhonics.rule: ar 組合發 /ɑːr/（汽車 car, 星星 star）

roleplayDialogue.speaker: 蘑菇 (Judy)
roleplayDialogue.en: Can I really make things different?

roleplayDialogue.speaker: AI 夥伴 (Nick)
roleplayDialogue.en: Of course! Change starts with you, and you're doing great.
roleplayDialogue.zh: 當然可以！改變從你開始，而且你現在做得棒極了。

movieQuotes.quote: Remember me, though I have to say goodbye. Remember me, don't let it make you cry.
movieQuotes.translation: 請記住我，雖然我必須說再見。請記住我，不要讓它令你哭泣。
movieQuotes.vibe: 音樂旋律、親情溫暖、色彩斑斕手作感

roleplayDialogue.speaker: 蘑菇
roleplayDialogue.en: Will you remember the song we sang together?
roleplayDialogue.zh: 你會記得我們一起唱過的這首歌嗎？

roleplayDialogue.speaker: AI 夥伴
roleplayDialogue.en: Always! I will never forget your beautiful melody.
roleplayDialogue.zh: 永遠都會！我絕不會忘記你美麗的旋律。

musicSongs.targetStudent: 知諾 (G7 男生，鋼琴/吉他)
musicSongs.vibe: 不插電木吉他、友情陪伴、溫暖清爽
musicSongs.keyLyrics: You can count on me like one, two, three, I'll be there. And I know when I need it I can count on you like four, three, two, you'll be there.
musicSongs.translation: 你可以依靠我，就像數著一二三，我就會出現；而我知道當我需要時，我也能依靠你，如同數著四三二，你就會在身邊。

rhymeFamilies.rule: 尾音押韻，聽旋律抓長母音 /i:/ 與雙母音 /eə/

musicSongs.learningActivity: 知諾彈奏吉他或鋼琴前奏，齡萱合唱，兩人邊聽邊圈出手寫單上的押韻家族詞彙。

musicSongs.targetStudent: 知諾 (G7 男生，鋼琴/吉他)
musicSongs.vibe: 經典鋼琴抒情、心靈沉澱、悠揚動人
musicSongs.keyLyrics: When I find myself in times of trouble, Mother Mary comes to me, speaking words of wisdom, let it be.
musicSongs.translation: 當我身處困境之時，聖母瑪利亞走近我身旁，輕聲訴說著智慧的話語：順其自然吧。
musicSongs.pianoChords: C - G - Am - F - C - G - F - C
musicSongs.learningActivity: 知諾彈奏 C-G-Am-F 鋼琴和弦，解析 wisdom (wise+dom) 的發音與字根拆解。

healingTracks.theme: 遊戲闖關與生活超短句（零壓力療癒）
healingTracks.vibe: 幽默輕鬆、棋盤通關感、無任何紅筆糾錯

太厲害了，一步到位，就像下棋直接將軍一樣帥氣！

In short, I believe that... Thank you!

examVocabBooster.sample: It is important to believe in ourselves.
Speaking English makes me feel confident.
We need creative ideas for the future.

gentleDialogues.speaker: Canadian Classmate
gentleDialogues.en: Hi Ning-Xi, welcome to Vancouver! Do you want to join our art club?
gentleDialogues.zh: 嗨凝希，歡迎來到溫哥華！你想加入我們的手作美術社嗎？

gentleDialogues.speaker: 凝希
gentleDialogues.en: Yes, I would love to! Thank you for asking.
gentleDialogues.zh: 好呀，我很樂意！謝謝你邀請我。
